cards.title: Phrasal verbs: las relaciones
cards.summary: Cinco phrasal verbs para hablar de amigos, pareja y familia.
cards.form: verbo + partícula (+ preposición): get along with, break up with
uses: Describir relaciones: I get along with my coworkers.
Historias de pareja: ask out, break up, make up.
Cuidar a alguien: look after (también take care of).
Con un pronombre, ask out se separa: ask her out.

pitfalls.wrong: I get along my brother.
pitfalls.right: I get along with my brother.
pitfalls.why: Para decir con quién, get along necesita with.

pitfalls.wrong: He asked out her.
pitfalls.right: He asked her out.
pitfalls.why: Con un pronombre, este va entre ask y out.

pitfalls.wrong: She cut with her boyfriend.
pitfalls.right: She broke up with her boyfriend.
pitfalls.why: Terminar o cortar con alguien es break up with; cut no se usa así.

pitfalls.wrong: Can you care my dog this weekend?
pitfalls.right: Can you look after my dog this weekend?
pitfalls.why: Cuidar es look after o take care of; care solo no lleva objeto directo.

examples.es: Me llevo bien con mis compañeros de trabajo.

examples.en: They broke up after five years together.
examples.es: Terminaron después de cinco años juntos.

examples.es: Nos peleamos, pero hicimos las paces.

examples.en: Who looks after your kids when you work?

example.en: My grandmother looks after my little brother.
example.es: Mi abuela cuida a mi hermanito.

example.en: He finally asked her out.
example.es: Por fin la invitó a salir.

cards.title: Phrasal verbs: trabajo y estudio
cards.summary: Cinco phrasal verbs muy comunes en la oficina y en clase.
cards.form: verbo + partícula; con un pronombre, este va en el medio: hand it in, look it up
uses: Tareas y trámites: hand in a report, fill out a form.
Buscar información: look up a word.
Resolver o entender: figure out how something works.
Recuperar el tiempo perdido: catch up.

pitfalls.wrong: I need to fill this form.
pitfalls.right: I need to fill out this form.
pitfalls.why: En inglés americano, llenar un formulario es fill out.

pitfalls.wrong: I have to deliver my homework.
pitfalls.right: I have to hand in my homework.
pitfalls.why: Entregar una tarea es hand in; deliver es repartir o llevar algo a un lugar.

pitfalls.wrong: Please hand in it tomorrow.
pitfalls.right: Please hand it in tomorrow.
pitfalls.why: Con un pronombre, este va entre hand e in.

pitfalls.wrong: I can't figure it.
pitfalls.right: I can't figure it out.
pitfalls.why: Para decir entender o resolver, figure necesita out.

examples.en: I looked up the address online.
examples.es: Busqué la dirección en internet.

examples.en: We finally figured out the answer.
examples.es: Por fin descubrimos la respuesta.

examples.en: Did you hand in the report?

cards.title: Phrasal verbs: planes
cards.summary: Cinco phrasal verbs para organizar, cambiar o cancelar planes.
cards.form: put off / call off / set up + objeto (separables) · come up with + objeto · show up (sin objeto)
uses: Cambiar la fecha: put off (posponer).
Cancelar: call off.
Organizar: set up a meeting.
Proponer ideas: come up with a plan; llegar o aparecer: show up.

pitfalls.wrong: Let's put off it until tomorrow.
pitfalls.right: Let's put it off until tomorrow.
pitfalls.why: Con un pronombre, este va entre put y off.

pitfalls.wrong: She came up a good idea.
pitfalls.right: She came up with a good idea.
pitfalls.why: Come up with lleva with antes de la idea.

pitfalls.wrong: He didn't present to the meeting.
pitfalls.right: He didn't show up to the meeting.
pitfalls.why: Llegar o aparecer en un lugar es show up; present significa presentar algo.

examples.es: Tuvimos que posponer nuestras vacaciones.

examples.en: The concert was called off at the last minute.

example.en: She came up with a great idea.

example.en: He showed up an hour late.

cards.title: Phrasal verbs: problemas y soluciones
cards.summary: Cinco phrasal verbs para hablar de problemas, de cómo aguantarlos y de cómo resolverlos.
cards.form: run out of / put up with + sustantivo · break down (sin objeto) · give up / work out (separables)
uses: Quedarse sin algo: run out of gas, run out of time.
Averías: The car broke down.
Rendirse o dejar un hábito: give up.
Resolver o salir bien: work out; aguantar algo molesto: put up with.

pitfalls.wrong: We stayed without milk.
pitfalls.right: We ran out of milk.
pitfalls.why: «Quedarse sin» algo es run out of; stay without es una traducción literal.

pitfalls.wrong: My car broke on the highway.
pitfalls.right: My car broke down on the highway.
pitfalls.why: Cuando un auto o una máquina deja de funcionar se usa break down.

pitfalls.wrong: I can't support this noise.
pitfalls.right: I can't put up with this noise.
pitfalls.why: Support es apoyar; soportar algo molesto es put up with.

cards.title: Phrasal verbs: de viaje
cards.summary: Cinco phrasal verbs para moverte en un viaje: hoteles, aeropuertos y transporte.
cards.form: check in / check out (sin objeto) · get on / get off + transporte · pick up + persona (separable)
uses: Hoteles y aeropuertos: check in al llegar, check out al irte.
Transporte: get on (subirse) y get off (bajarse) del autobús, el tren o el avión.
Ir a buscar a alguien: pick someone up.
Para autos y taxis se dice get in y get out of.

pitfalls.wrong: I'll pick up you at the airport.
pitfalls.right: I'll pick you up at the airport.
pitfalls.why: Con un pronombre, este va entre pick y up.

pitfalls.wrong: We went down from the bus at the last stop.
pitfalls.right: We got off the bus at the last stop.
pitfalls.why: Bajarse de un transporte es get off, no go down.

pitfalls.wrong: Get on the taxi.
pitfalls.right: Get in the taxi.
pitfalls.why: Para autos y taxis se usa get in; get on es para autobuses, trenes y aviones.

cards.title: Phrasal verbs: la tecnología
cards.summary: Cinco phrasal verbs para usar computadoras, teléfonos y aplicaciones.
cards.form: verbo + partícula (+ preposición): back up, log in to, sign up for
uses: Cuentas y aplicaciones: log in, log out, sign up for.
Cuidar tus archivos: back up (hacer una copia de seguridad).
Conectar aparatos: plug in (enchufar).
Back up y plug in se separan con un pronombre: back it up, plug it in.

pitfalls.wrong: I need to enter in my account.
pitfalls.right: I need to log in to my account.
pitfalls.why: Entrar a una cuenta es log in (to), no enter in.

pitfalls.wrong: Back up them before the update.
pitfalls.right: Back them up before the update.
pitfalls.why: Con un pronombre, este va entre back y up.

pitfalls.wrong: I registered me for the course online.
pitfalls.right: I signed up for the course online.
pitfalls.why: Inscribirse es sign up for (o register for), sin me.

pitfalls.wrong: Don't forget to close session.
pitfalls.right: Don't forget to log out.
pitfalls.why: Cerrar sesión es log out.
